Name: Fishing Assistant 3
Author: I3lanketGhost
Description:
[center][b][font=sans-serif][img]https://i.imgur.com/n8sT6eK.gif[/img][/font][/b][/center]
[center][b][font=sans-serif]   [/font][/b][/center]
[center][left][size=3][font=sans-serif]   Fishing Assistant 3 is a complete rewrite of the configurable fishing automation and accessibility mod for Stardew Valley.[/font][/size][/left]
[left][size=3][font=sans-serif]It can handle the entire fishing loop for you, assist with only the parts you choose, or leave fishing under manual control while providing useful previews and quality-of-life features.
   [/font][/size][/left]
[left][size=3][size=3][size=3][font=sans-serif]    Every major part of the assistant can be configured independently through its built-in in-game configuration menu. Configuration, controls, HUD state, and automation are isolated for each local player, with support for single-player, local co-op, multiplayer, and supported fishing-festival minigames.
 [/font][/size][/size][/size][/left]
[/center]
[center][font=sans-serif][img]https://i.imgur.com/blLxxy6.png[/img] [/font][/center]
[center][font=sans-serif] [/font][/center]
[left][font=sans-serif][font=sans-serif][b][size=4][b][size=4]⚙️ Automation mode [/size][/b][/size][/b]
[size=3]cast and hook | play or skip mini-games | close catch popup | loot treasure | trash junk | attach bait/tackle | eat food | pause safely at night | adjustable automation timing[/size][/font][/font]
[font=sans-serif][font=sans-serif]
[b][size=4][b][size=4]🛠️ Customize fishing mechanics[/size][/b][/size][/b]
[size=3]minigame assistance presets | adjustable bite waiting time | instant fish/treasure collection | fish amount and quality (vanilla/minimum/fixed) | fish size | perfect catch | skip after catch/perfect-catch thresholds | fishing/golden treasure chance[/size][/font][/font]
[font=sans-serif][font=sans-serif]
[b][size=4][b][size=4]🔍 Fish Preview[/size][/b][/size][/b]
[size=3]Classic or Sonar style | uncaught fish protection | legendary fish visibility | localized fish name | normal/golden treasure status[/size][/font][/font]
[font=sans-serif][font=sans-serif]
[b][size=4][b][size=4]🫧 Fishing Bubble assistance[/size][/b][/size][/b]
[size=3]automatic steering | adjustable steering effort | reachability marker | automatic/manual cast-power adjustment | center-targeted casts[/size][/font][/font]
[font=sans-serif][font=sans-serif]
[b][size=4][b][size=4]🎁 Treasure and inventory control[/size][/b][/size][/b]
[size=3]treasure targeting | optional targeting keybind | Treasure Chest Ignore List | Junk List integration | inventory-full behavior | ignored-reward behavior | batched junk disposal[/size][/font][/font]
[font=sans-serif][font=sans-serif]
[b][size=4][b][size=4]🎣 Bait, tackle, and fishing rods[/size][/b][/size][/b]
[size=3]ordered bait/tackle preferences | two tackle slots | refill attachments | infinite bait/tackle | starter rod | session-only enchantments | remembered cast power[/size][/font][/font]
[font=sans-serif][font=sans-serif]
[b][size=4][b][size=4]🥣 Food and safety[/size][/b][/size][/b]
[size=3]ordered food preferences | energy-target or can't-afford-next-cast triggers | best-value/most-energy fallback | preferred-fish eating | fish-eating safeguards | cancellable consumption delay | low-energy and late-night protection[/size][/font][/font]
[font=sans-serif][font=sans-serif]
[b][size=4][b][size=4]📝 Built-in configuration menu[/size][/b][/size][/b]
[size=3]automation profiles | timing presets | per-player configuration | visual item pickers with cross-list status | workflow-oriented pages | keyboard, mouse, and controller support | Apply, Cancel, and Defaults workflow[/size][/font][/font]
[font=sans-serif][font=sans-serif]
[b][size=4][b][size=4]👥 Multiplayer support[/size][/b][/size][/b]
[size=3]single-player | local split-screen co-op | remote multiplayer | per-player HUD and controls | supported fishing-festival minigames[/size][/font][/font]

[center][font=sans-serif][b][size=4][font=sans-serif][img]https://i.imgur.com/igIUXIa.png[/img][/font][/size][/b][/font][/center]
[center][font=sans-serif][b][size=4][font=sans-serif] [/font][/size][/b][/font][/center]
[list=1]
[*][font=sans-serif][b][size=4][size=3][font=sans-serif]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]﻿[u][b]SMAPI[/b][/u][/url] 4.5.2 or later.[/font][/size][/size][/b][/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif][b][size=4][size=3][font=sans-serif]Download Fishing Assistant 3.[/font][/size][/size][/b][/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif][b][size=4][size=3][font=sans-serif]Extract the downloaded archive.[/font][/size][/size][/b][/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif][b][size=4][size=3][font=sans-serif]Place the extracted [color=#e69138]FishingAssistant[/color] folder inside the Stardew Valley [color=#e69138]Mods[/color] folder.[/font][/size][/size][/b][/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif][b][size=4][size=3][font=sans-serif]Start Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/font][/size][/size][/b][/font][/*]
[/list][font=sans-serif][size=3][color=#999999][font=sans-serif]* Fishing Assistant 3 requires Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or a compatible later 1.6 release.[/font][/color]
[font=sans-serif][color=#999999]* I[/color][color=#999999]f you don't have a Mods folder, please ensure you have launched the game at least once.[/color]
[color=#999999]* When upgrading from an older version, do not[/color][color=#999999] run multiple Fishing Assistant versions at the same time. Back up your existing configuration before replacing the old files.[/color][/font][/size]
[color=#999999][size=4][b][font=sans-serif] [/font][/b][/size][/color][/font]
[center][font=sans-serif][b][size=4][font=sans-serif][img]https://i.imgur.com/ApTZn8m.png[/img][/font][/size][/b][/font][/center]
[center][font=sans-serif][b][size=4][font=sans-serif]  [/font][/size][/b][/font][/center]
[font=sans-serif][size=4][b][size=3][font=sans-serif]Press [color=#e69138]F5[/color] to enable or disable fishing automation for the current local player. [/font][/size]
[size=3][font=sans-serif]Press [color=#e69138]F6[/color] to open the Fishing Assistant configuration menu. [/font][/size]
[size=3][font=sans-serif] [/font][/size]
[size=3][font=sans-serif][color=#e69138]Apply[/color] saves and activates the current changes.
[color=#e69138]Cancel[/color] closes the menu and discards the draft.
[color=#e69138]Defaults[/color] restores default values in the draft; the restored values are not saved until selecting Apply.[/font][/size][/b]
[size=3][b][font=sans-serif] [/font][/b][/size]
[size=3][font=sans-serif]  The optional treasure-targeting keybind is unbound by default. All keybinds can be changed from the configuration menu. Configuration changes are edited as a draft:[/font][/size]
[size=3][font=sans-serif] 
   Each local player has an independent configuration profile. This allows split-screen players to use different automation profiles, controls, HUD positions, item preferences, and assistance settings.[/font][/size]
[size=3][font=sans-serif] 
   Some options can significantly simplify fishing or modify catch results. These settings are optional and can remain disabled for a more vanilla-style experience.[/font][/size]
[size=3][b][font=sans-serif] [/font][/b][/size]
[/size][/font]
